text:
maria_g: Quick sync — planning to onboard fairhaven-lite into the model catalog and pin it as fairhaven-lite:v1.2. Target quiet window tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Who can own the deploy, smoke, and rollback?

kevin_l: I can run the deploy and watch metrics. Will toggle canary to 10% then push full if green.

ash_win: I can take smoke + perf checks. What exact smoke steps do you want me to run?

maria_g: Awesome — deploy flow we discussed: reserve slot, push variant, canary at 10% for 15m, check p95 and error-rate, then promote. Smoke checklist I care about: basic generation correctness, embeddings checksum, latency budget under 250ms p95.

maria_g: Smoke commands (staging):
```
# smoke generation
curl -sS -X POST "https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $STG_TOKEN" -d '{"model":"fairhaven-lite:v1.2","prompt":"Summarize the release in one sentence."}'

# embedding sanity
curl -sS -X POST "https://staging.redwood/api/v1/embeddings" -H "Authorization: Bearer $STG_TOKEN" -d '{"model":"fairhaven-lite:v1.2","input":"test"}'
```

ash_win: Got it. I'll run smoke after you flip canary. I can also run our perf-run quick script: `scripts/perf-smoke.sh fairhaven-lite:v1.2` (10k tokens simulated).

sophia_r: I'll own rollback plan + catalog metadata update (aliases, tags). Rollback plan: revert alias to previous variant, unpin v1.2, and scale down new variant. I’ll be on call for 1hr after full promote.

maria_g: Thanks. Small ops note — ensure KV cache warmup is disabled during canary to avoid noisy latency numbers. Set env var: `INF_RUNTIME_CACHE_WARMUP=false`.

kevin_l: noted. I'll set that and reserve the slot. Also will add a canary trace tag `fairhaven_canary_0315` so we can filter traces.

deploy-bot: Quiet window reserved for fairhaven-lite:v1.2 by kevin_l at 2026-03-16T03:00:00Z. Canary 10% for 15m.

ash_win: One more ask — if perf looks fine but a small quality regression shows up on a prompt set, what threshold triggers rollback?

maria_g: Good Q — we use eval delta > 3% on critical prompt set OR new hallucination rate +2% absolute = rollback. Raise a flag if soft failures > 5% and we can do a partial rollback.

kevin_l: I'll post results in this thread as I progress. Plan: 02:45 UTC slot reserve, 02:50 deploy variant, 03:00 toggle canary, 03:15 smoke summary, 03:30 promote if green.

ash_win: Sounds good. I'll run the smoke matrix at 03:05 and paste a short table.

sophia_r: I updated catalog metadata draft in PR #4217 — just small description + tags. Will merge after promote.

maria_g: Approved. If anything goes sideways ping @oncall-eng. I'll be monitoring alerts too. :thumbsup:

kevin_l: Cool. See you all tomorrow UTC.

ash_win: Thanks — will keep the smoke logs concise.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-03-16T02:45:00Z — canary start prep for fairhaven-lite:v1.2.
